mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slack condition (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals that the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising above 2.0% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising above 240, it signals an accelerating inflation environment that leads to a contraction in equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (base 2017=100) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 240 signals inflationary pressures that lead to negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 240, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is slowing (PAYEMS < 139000) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising above 5.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion, a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 450000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during early-cycle expansion when RSAFS > 450000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
